steps.what: Hear the colleague on this year's teaching and research.
Read the colleague's activity note for this faculty review.
Draft review packet v1 from the stored goal, course code, and completion count.
Judge review packet v1 lists that goal, course, and count.
File checked review packet v1 on the talent record.
Write faculty performance evaluations from the meeting account.

tasks.design: A configured copy from {TALENT} and {LMS} builds review packet v1 from the stored goal, the course code, and the completion count. She checks that packet, and {TALENT} files the same version. She still meets the colleague and writes the faculty performance evaluation herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The goal, the course code, and the completion count sit in two records, and the evaluation itself is a judgement about a colleague.
tasks.enabler_now: Those three fields already have names in the talent record and the learning record, so a configured copy can assemble them.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing the colleague and judging the year's work stay with her. A missing field is typed from the activity note.
tasks.human_edge: She knows whether the year's teaching and research match the goal, which a field copy cannot decide.
tasks.altitude: She still meets the colleague and writes the evaluation. The review packet is filed only after she has checked it.

reach.learn: Which goals that teacher already stored before the review meeting.

evidence.claim: Copying a stored goal, a course code, and a completion count into one packet is configuration. No product in this digest evaluates a colleague's performance.
Works-council consent covers systems able to monitor staff.

assumptions: The boundary is one annual review of one colleague in the mathematics department.

The named fields are goal text, course code, and completion count. The talent record produces the goal text. The learning record produces the course code and the completion count. If a field is empty she types it from the activity note.
The person who hears, reads, and writes today is the mathematics teacher. The machine appears only when it drafts the packet and when it files that same packet.
The packet is those three fields. It is not a view that monitors staff, so steady upkeep is the occasional repair of a missing field, priced below, and not a wider build.
unknowns: Whether goal text, course code, and completion count are already stored as named fields on the talent record and the learning record.

already_counted.description: She checks the packet before it is filed.

incremental.description: Typing a goal or a completion count when that field is missing. The check does not cover an empty field.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the stored goal or the completion count is missing, she types it from the activity note, so less of the lookup is removed.

tasks.short: Supervise undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship, and research work.

steps.what: Hear the student on undergraduate teaching, internship, or research work.
Read the research draft or the internship log.
Decide the next supervision point for that teaching or research.
Write the supervision note from the meeting and the log.

tasks.design: She meets the student and reads the research draft or the internship log in {DOCS}. She decides the next supervision point and writes the supervision note herself. No machine step is added, because this work is the meeting and the reading.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is a meeting about a draft or a log, and almost none of it sits in a standard record.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the meeting. The draft and the log are already documents she can read.
tasks.still_hard: Each student's teaching, internship, or research is different, and the next step is a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the student's work in the meeting and decides what that student should do next.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in her week. She still meets the student, reads the draft or the log, and writes the supervision note.

reach.task: Supervise undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship, and research work.
reach.learn: Which lab notes that teacher already keeps before supervising a student's research.

evidence.claim: Supervision of a student's teaching, internship, and research is a meeting and a reading of a draft or a log. No product in this digest supervises that work.

assumptions: The boundary is one supervision meeting with one student about teaching, an internship, or research.

There is no structured field contract for a machine. The research draft and the internship log are documents the student already wrote. If either is only on paper, she reads it in the meeting and the reading step is the same work.
The person who hears, reads, decides, and writes today is the mathematics teacher. The machine does not appear.
No system is built, so steady upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether the research draft and the internship log are already documents she can open, or only paper she is handed in the meeting.

incremental.description: No system is built, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The meeting, the reading, and the supervision note stay as they are, so there is no time removed.

tasks.short: Act as advisers to student organizations.

steps.what: Read the written proposal from the student organization.
Advise student organizations in their meeting.
Write the advice note from what she told the officers.

tasks.design: She reads the organization's proposal in {DOCS}, advises the student organization in the meeting, and writes the advice note herself. No machine step is added. The proposal is unstructured, and the advice is given in the room.
tasks.previous_blocker: The organization's proposal is unstructured, and the advice is given in the meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: She can read the proposal beforehand. Advising stays with her, and no model is required.
tasks.still_hard: The advice depends on what the officers say in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She answers the organization in the meeting. A summary of the proposal would not replace that answer.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in her week. She still reads the proposal, meets the organization, and writes the advice note.

reach.task: Act as advisers to student organizations.
reach.learn: Which organization proposals that coordinator already keeps before an advice meeting.

evidence.claim: Advising a student organization is a meeting about its proposal. No product in this digest advises a student organization.

assumptions: The boundary is one meeting with one student organization about one written proposal.

There is no structured field contract for a machine. The proposal is a document the officers already wrote. If they bring no document, she hears the request in the meeting and the reading step is that conversation.
The person who reads, advises, and writes today is the mathematics teacher. The machine does not appear.
No system is built, so steady upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether the organization sends a written proposal before the meeting.

incremental.description: No system is built, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The proposal reading, the meeting, and the advice note stay as they are, so there is no time removed.

tasks.short: Participate in student recruitment, registration, and placement activities.

steps.what: Meet prospective students during recruitment activities.
Read the application for programme, term, and placement.
Decide whether this applicant is placed.
Copy programme code, term, and placement into student registry rows v1.
Judge student registry rows v1 match that code, term, and placement.
File checked registry rows v1 in the student registry as registration.
Write place confirmation v1 for the placement she decided.
Judge place confirmation v1 states that placement and no other.
Send place confirmation v1 to the applicant.

tasks.design: She meets prospective students and decides the placement. A configured copy then writes programme code, start term, and placement status as registry rows v1 in the {OTHER} student registry. She checks those rows, and the registry files the same version. She writes place confirmation v1 and sends that version herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Registration retypes programme code, start term, and placement status that the application already holds, while recruitment stays a meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Those three fields are structured on the application, so the student registry can be configured to receive them after she decides.
tasks.still_hard: The recruitment meeting and the placement decision stay with her. A blank field is retyped.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether the applicant is placed, and she sends the confirmation.
tasks.altitude: She still attends recruitment and decides placement. Registry rows are filed only after she has checked them, and she still sends the confirmation.

reach.task: Participate in student recruitment, registration, and placement activities.
reach.learn: Which placement fields that teacher already records before telling an applicant.

evidence.claim: Copying programme code, start term, and placement status into a student registry is configuration of named fields. No product in this digest registers a student.

assumptions: The boundary is one recruitment activity and one applicant's registration and placement. It does not set a grade.

The named fields are programme code, start term, and placement status. The application produces programme code and start term. She produces placement status when she decides. If a field is blank she retypes it, and the copy does not invent it.
The person who meets, reads, decides, writes, and sends today is the mathematics teacher. The machine appears only when it drafts the registry rows and when it files those same rows.
Steady upkeep is retyping a blank field, priced below. Replacing the registry mapping when a field is renamed is the same work.
unknowns: Whether programme code, start term, and placement status are fields on the application the student registry can read.

already_counted.description: She checks the registry rows before they are filed.
She checks the place confirmation before she sends it.

incremental.description: Retyping programme code or start term when the application leaves it blank.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When programme code or start term is blank on the application, she retypes it, so the registry copy saves less. The recruitment meeting is not shortened.

role.altitude: She still decides faculty evaluations, supervision, advice to organizations, and placement. Review packets and registry rows are filed only after she has checked them. Recruitment meetings stay in her week.

role.ambitious_version: She still meets colleagues and students. A review packet and registry rows are prepared for her to check. She still writes the evaluation, the supervision note, and the advice, and she still sends the place confirmation.
